recentItems.title: Why some Chinese F&B chains have exited Hong Kong
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Mainland Chinese food and beverage chains have aggressively expanded into Hong Kong in recent years, but some are now hitting major roadblocks. Global beverage and dessert chain Mixue downsized its business in Hong Kong, while other brands like Fufuland and Ningji exited the Hong Kong market. Hong Kong’s relatively high rent and labour costs have been a challenge for many of the businesses, which normally rely on a high-volume, low-price business model common in mainland China.

recentItems.title: Robots protest to demand AI regulation
recentItems.description:
About 30 robots holding flags and chanting slogans have staged a protest outside Poland’s digital affairs ministry in Warsaw to demand improved AI regulation. Democratism, the advocacy group that organised Monday’s event, said the robotic rally aimed to spark debate about the impact of AI and robotics on the labour market.

recentItems.title: Rebuilt bridge in flood-ravaged Nepal restores hope
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Nepali authorities have completed a new bridge over the Tadi river, reconnecting the town of Devighat with Kathmandu. The span replaces a bridge that was swept away by devastating flash flooding caused by the collapse of a glacier last month. The new connection has restored access to essential supplies and is bringing renewed hope to local communities.

recentItems.title: Tung Chee-hwa: Hong Kong remembers its first chief executive
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Read more: https://sc.mp/46f25d

A shipping tycoon who was thrust onto the international stage as Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa is being remembered as a defining figure of the city’s modern history. Following his death on Tuesday at the age of 89, many are recalling Tung’s role as an elder statesman and consummate diplomat, who led Hong Kong through post-handover challenges including economic, public health and political crises.

recentItems.title: Indonesian journalists, crew missing near erupting volcano
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Indonesian authorities are searching for five journalists, two crew members and a guide who are missing near the erupting Mount Anak Krakatoa. The journalists were sent out to capture photos and videos of the eruption, which caused disruptions at several airports and blanketed major cities in volcanic ash for days. The search began on Tuesday, but rough seas and poor visibility have hindered rescue operations.

recentItems.title: How the Education University of Hong Kong is nurturing talent for social benefit
recentItems.description:
In partnership with: @EdUHKnews 

It has been 10 years since the Education University of Hong Kong was granted the status of being one of the city’s publicly funded universities. As the institution celebrates this milestone, its president, Professor John Lee Chi-kin, looks ahead. He discusses how it continues to develop its academic programmes, research work and partnerships around its philosophy of “nurturing talent while cultivating virtues”.

recentItems.title: Beijing accuses Philippine defence chief of ‘grandstanding’
recentItems.description:
China has accused Philippine officials of “grandstanding” after Manila’s defence secretary publicly read aloud a Chinese diplomat’s note reiterating Beijing’s stance on the South China Sea arbitration. Gilberto Teodoro described the incident, which happened at the Seoul Defence Dialogue on Tuesday, as “coercion, bullying and aggression”.

recentItems.title: WATCH: Hong Kong’s first astronaut Lai Ka-ying gives live lecture from space
recentItems.description:
Hong Kong’s first astronaut Lai Ka-ying and her two fellow Shenzhou-23 crew members are delivering a live lecture from space. The activity, jointly organised by the Hong Kong and Macau governments and the China Manned Space Agency, includes an expert lecture, an in-orbit demonstration and a question-and-answer session to showcase the environment in space.

recentItems.title: Racing driver pulls rival from a burning car at China GT
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Dashcam footage captured the moment that driver Loek Hartog risked his own life to pull rival Ollie Millroy out of a burning car after a three-vehicle collision at the Shanghai International Circuit. The crash, which took place during the China GT Championship on Saturday, sparked fierce criticism of the organisers’ safety protocols and emergency response. Ollie Millroy remains in intensive care at a Shanghai hospital.
